```
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}

```

assistant: ```
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    /*@ 
      @ requires rec1 != null && rec2 != null;
      @ requires rec1.length == 4 && rec2.length == 4;
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == !(rec2[1] >= rec1[3] ||
      @                      rec2[3] <= rec1[1] ||
      @                      rec2[0] >= rec1[2] ||
      @                      rec2[2] <= rec1[0]);
      @*/
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    /*@ 
      @ requires adjacencyMat != null;
      @ requires (\forall int r; 0 <= r && r < adjacencyMat.length;
      @               adjacencyMat[r] != null && adjacencyMat[r].length == adjacencyMat.length);
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == (\forall int p,q; 0 <= p && p < adjacencyMat.length &&
      @                                0 <= q && q < adjacencyMat.length;
      @                         adjacencyMat[p][q] == adjacencyMat[q][p]);
      @ pure
      @*/
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= nVert;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p && p < i;
        //@                 (\forall int q; p+1 <= q && q < nVert;
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
        }
        return sign * res;
    }
}
```

```
public class Mul {
    //@ requires x != Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    //@ requires y != Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (long) x * (long) y;
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
        //@ maintaining res == (long) i * (long) n;
        //@ loop_writes res, i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
            //@ maintaining res == (long) i * (long) n + (long) j;
            //@ loop_writes res, j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
        }
        return sign * res;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

```

```
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length;
```

```
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    //@  requires nums != null;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == ((\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < nums.length - 1; nums[k] < nums[k+1]) ||
    //@                       (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < nums.length - 1; nums[k] > nums[k+1]));
    //@  pure
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining inc <==> (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i && j+1 < n; nums[j] < nums[j+1]);
        //@ maintaining dec <==> (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i && j+1 < n; nums[j] > nums[j+1]);
        //@ loop_writes inc, dec, i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsPrefix {
```
```
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;

        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class Find {
```

```
    //@  requires \exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] == elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures 0 <= \result < arr.length;
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  ensures arr[\result] == elem;

    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;

        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
```

```
public class CompareArray {

        if (a == null || b == null) {
            return a == b;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

```
```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == null;
    //@  also
    //@  requires a != null && b != null && (long) a.length + b.length <= Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@  assigns \result, \result[*];
    //@  ensures \result != null;
    //@  ensures \result.length == a.length + b.length;
    //@  ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length; \result[i] == a[i]);
```

```
    //@  ensures (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < b.length; \result[a.length + j] == b[j]);
    //@  ensures \fresh(\result);
    //@  behaviors complete;
    //@  behaviors disjoint;
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; ret[j] == a[j]);
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < m; ret[j] == a[j]);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; ret[m + j] == b[j]);
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ClosedInterval {
```
```
    //@ also
    //@   requires a > b;
    //@   assigns \nothing;
    //@   ensures \result == null;
    //@ also
    //@   requires a <= b;
    //@   assigns \nothing;
    //@   ensures \result != null;
    //@   ensures \result.length == b - a + 1;
    //@   ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result.length; \result[i] == a + i;
```

```
      @ ensures (operator != '+' && operator != '-' && operator != '*' && operator != '/' && operator != '%') ==> \result == -1;
      @ pure
      @*/
    public static int calculate(int num1, int num2, char operator) {

        int output;

        switch (operator) {
        case '+':
            output = num1 + num2;
            break;

        case '-':
            output = num1 - num2;
            break;

        case '*':
            output = num1 * num2;
            break;

        case '/':
            output = num1 / num2;
            break;

        case '%':
            output = num1 % num2;
            break;

        default:
            return -1;
        }
        return output;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
```
```
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```
    public static long calculate(int num1, int num2, char operator) {

        long output;

        switch (operator) {
        case '+':
            output = (long)num1 + num2;
            break;

        case '-':
            output = (long)num1 - num2;
            break;

        case '*':
            output = (long)num1 * num2;
            break;

        case '/':
            output = (long)num1 / num2;
            break;

        case '%':
            output = (long)num1 % num2;
            break;

        default:
            return -1;
        }
        return output;
    }
}
```

```
public class Swap1 {
    public static void swap(int[] arr, int a, int b) {
        if (arr == null || a >= arr.length || a < 0 || b >= arr.length ||
            b < 0) {
            return;
        }
        int temp = arr[a];
        arr[a] = arr[b];
        arr[b] = temp;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
        if (arr == null || arr.length == 0) return -1;
```

```
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= arr.length - 1;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < i ==> (\forall int j; k+1 <= j && j < arr.length ==> arr[k] != arr[j]));
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length - 1; i++) {
            //@ maintaining i+1 <= j && j <= arr.length;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < i ==> (\forall int jj; k+1 <= jj && jj < arr.length ==> arr[k] != arr[jj]));
            //@ maintaining (\forall int h; i+1 <= h && h < j ==> arr[i] != arr[h]);
            //@ loop_writes j;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
```

```
    //@  requires arr == null || \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] != elem;
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)

        return -1;
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

                return null;
            }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      ensures (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < a.length; a[k] == \old(a[k]));
      ensures (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < b.length; b[k] == \old(b[k]));
    @*/
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        /*@ 
          maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
          maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; ret[j] == a[j]);
```
```
          loop_writes ret[*];
          decreases m - i;
        @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        /*@ 
          maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
          maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < m; ret[j] == a[j]);
          maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; ret[m + j] == b[j]);
          loop_writes ret[*];
          decreases n - i;
        @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    /*@ 
      requires true;
      assigns \nothing;
      // If null or empty, result is true
      ensures (digits == null || digits.length == 0) ==> \result == true;
      // Otherwise, result iff all mirrored pairs match strobogrammatic mapping
      ensures (digits != null && digits.length > 0) ==> (
        \result == (
          (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < digits.length/2;
            ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 0) ||
             (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1) ||
             (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8) ||
             (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9) ||
             (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6))
          )
          &&
          // If odd length, middle digit must be 0,1,or 8
          (digits.length % 2 == 0 || 
            (digits[digits.length / 2] == 0 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 1 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 8)
          )
        )
      );
    @*/
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= len/2;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
        //@          ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0) ||
        //@           (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1) ||
        //@           (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||
        //@           (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9) ||
        //@           (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6));
        //@ loop_writes i, a, b;
        //@ decreases (len / 2) - i;

                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||

                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {

            }
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
      ensures (digits != null && digits.length > 0) ==> (
        \result == (
          (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < digits.length/2;
            ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 0) ||
             (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1) ||
             (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8) ||
             (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9) ||
             (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6))
          )
          &&
          // If odd length, middle digit must be 0,1,or 8
          (digits.length % 2 == 0 || 
            (digits[digits.length / 2] == 0 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 1 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 8)
          )
        )
      );
    @*/
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= len/2;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
        //@          ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0) ||
        //@           (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1) ||
        //@           (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||
        //@           (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9) ||
        //@           (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6));
        //@ loop_writes \nothing;
        //@ decreases (len / 2) - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;

```
```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class Find {
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            if (arr[i] == elem)
                return i;
        return -1;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {

                return null;
            }

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;
```

```
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
                if (adjacencyMat[i][j] != adjacencyMat[j][i]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    //@ requires nums != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == ((\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] < nums[i+1]) || (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] > nums[i+1]));
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= (n <= 1 ? 0 : n - 1);
        //@ maintaining inc == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] < nums[j+1]);
        //@ maintaining dec == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] > nums[j+1]);
        //@ loop_writes i, inc, dec;
        //@ decreases (n <= 1 ? 0 : n - 1) - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@        ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 0) ||
    //@         (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1) ||
    //@         (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8) ||

    //@       (digits[digits.length / 2] == 0 ||
    //@        digits[digits.length / 2] == 1 ||
    //@        digits[digits.length / 2] == 8))
    //@ );
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
```

```
public class MatrixSum {
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                c[i][j] = a[i][j] + b[i][j];
            }
        }

        return c;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
            return null;

    }
```

```
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {

        if (x < 0) {
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@ pure
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@                                           digits[digits.length / 2] == 1 ||
    //@                                           digits[digits.length / 2] == 8))
    //@   );
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
      @ requires mat != null;
      @ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < mat.length; mat[i] != null);
      @ requires mat.length == 0 || (\forall int i; 0 <= i < mat.length; mat[i].length == mat[0].length);
      @ assignable \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == (\forall int i; 1 <= i < mat.length; \forall int j; 1 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i-1][j-1]);

        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```
    //@ assigns \nothing;
```

```
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    //@ requires adjacencyMat != null;
    //@ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[i] != null && adjacencyMat[i].length == adjacencyMat.length);
    //@ assignable \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (\forall int p,q; 0 <= p && p < adjacencyMat.length && 0 <= q && q < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[p][q] == adjacencyMat[q][p]);
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= nVert;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int p,q; 0 <= p && p < i && p < q && q < nVert; adjacencyMat[p][q] == adjacencyMat[q][p]);

            //@ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= nVert;

            //@ loop_writes \nothing;
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
```
```
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;

        int i = 0;
```

```
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {

                inc = false;

            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class DivArrayByTwo {
    public static void DivArrayByTwo(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null)
            return;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; ++i) {

        }
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    //@ requires true;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures (digits == null || digits.length == 0) ==> \result == true;
    //@ ensures digits != null && digits.length > 0 ==>
    //@   (\result == (
    //@       (\forall int i; 0 <= i < digits.length/2;
    //@           ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - 1 - i] == 0) ||
    //@            (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - 1 - i] == 1) ||
    //@            (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - 1 - i] == 8) ||
    //@            (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - 1 - i] == 9) ||
    //@            (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - 1 - i] == 6))
    //@       )
    //@       &&
    //@       (digits.length % 2 == 0 || (digits[digits.length/2] == 0 || digits[digits.length/2] == 1 || digits[digits.length/2] == 8))
    //@   ));
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= len/2;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; 
        //@     ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - 1 - j] == 0) ||
        //@      (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - 1 - j] == 1) ||
        //@      (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - 1 - j] == 8) ||
        //@      (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - 1 - j] == 9) ||
        //@      (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - 1 - j] == 6));
        //@ loop_writes i, a, b;
        //@ decreases (len/2) - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {

        return ret;

}
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    //@ requires a != null && a.length == 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == -1;
    //@ also
    //@ requires a != null && a.length > 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures 0 <= \result && \result < a.length;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[\result] >= a[i]);
    //@ ensures (\forall int j; 0 <= j < \result; a[j] < a[\result]);
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int biggest = 0;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= index && index <= a.length;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= biggest && biggest < a.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j && j < index; a[biggest] >= a[j];
```

```
public class Calculator1 {
    public static int calculate(int num1, int num2, char operator) {

        int output;

        switch (operator) {
        case '+':
            output = num1 + num2;
            break;

        case '-':
            output = num1 - num2;
            break;

        case '*':
            output = num1 * num2;
            break;

        case '/':
            output = num1 / num2;
            break;

        case '%':
            output = num1 % num2;
            break;

        default:
            return -1;
        }
        return output;
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
```

```
    //@ pure
    public static boolean isPalindrome(String s) {
        int n = s.length();

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; s.charAt(j) == s.charAt(n - 1 - j);
```

```
public class TwoSum {
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {

            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }

    }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

        }

    }
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {

}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsPrefix {
```
```
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
```

```
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      requires a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE;
      assigns \nothing;
      ensures \result == null;
      also
      // Case when result is a newly allocated concatenation
      requires a != null && b != null && (long) a.length + b.length <= Integer.MAX_VALUE;
      assigns \nothing;
      ensures \result != null;

      ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length; \result[i] == a[i]);

                  \result[k] == (k < a.length ? a[k] : b[k - a.length]));
      ensures \result != a && \result != b;
    @*/
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;

        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; ret[j] == a[j]);
```

```
    also
      requires a != null && b != null;
      assigns \nothing;
      ensures \result == (a.length == b.length && (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length; a[i] == b[i]));
    @*/
    /*@ pure @*/
    public static boolean arrcmp(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null) {
            return a == b;
        }
        if (a.length != b.length) {
            return false;
        }

        //@ maintaining a != null && b != null;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= a.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; a[j] == b[j];
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases a.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (a[i] != b[i]) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
```

```
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}

```
```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||

                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    /*@
      @ requires adjacencyMat != null;
      @ requires (\forall int r; 0 <= r < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[r] != null && adjacencyMat[r].length == adjacencyMat.length);
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == (\forall int p, q; 0 <= p && p < adjacencyMat.length && 0 <= q && q < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[p][q] == adjacencyMat[q][p]);
      @ pure
      @*/
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= nVert;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p < i; (\forall int q; p+1 <= q < nVert; adjacencyMat[p][q] == adjacencyMat[q][p]));
        //@ loop_writes i;

            //@ maintaining (\forall int k; i+1 <= k < j; adjacencyMat[i][k] == adjacencyMat[k][i]);
            //@ maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p < i; (\forall int q; p+1 <= q < nVert; adjacencyMat[p][q] == adjacencyMat[q][p]));
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases nVert - j;

                }
            }
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    //@  requires true;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (a != null
    //@                       && a.length > 0
    //@                       && (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length;
    //@                              a[i] != null && a[i].length == a.length
    //@                              && (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < a.length;
    //@                                     (i == j ? a[i][j] == 1 : a[i][j] == 0))));
    //@  pure
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int p; 0 <= p && p < i;
        //@            a[p] != null && a[p].length == n
        //@            && (\forall int q; 0 <= q && q < n; (p == q ? a[p][q] == 1 : a[p][q] == 0));
        //@ loop_writes \nothing;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            //@ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
            //@ maintaining \forall int q; 0 <= q && q < j;
            //@            (i == q ? a[i][q] == 1 : a[i][q] == 0);
            //@ loop_writes \nothing;
            //@ decreases n - j;
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {

            sign = -sign;

        long res = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
```

```
        if (x < 0) {
```

```
    //@  requires \exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] == elem;

    //@  ensures arr[\result] == elem;
    //@ also
    //@  requires arr == null || \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {

            return -1;
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}

```

```
        /*@

          @   maintaining 0 <= biggest && biggest < a.length;
          @   maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < index; a[biggest] >= a[j]);
          @   maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < biggest; a[k] < a[biggest]);
          @   loop_writes index, biggest;
          @   decreases a.length - index;
          @*/
        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```
public class ClosedInterval {
```
```
    /*@
      requires true;
      // case: a > b -> return null
      ensures a > b ==> \result == null;
      assigns \nothing;
      also
      // case: a <= b -> return array [a..b]
      requires a <= b;
      ensures a <= b ==> \result != null;
      ensures a <= b ==> \result.length == b - a + 1;
      ensures a <= b ==> (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < \result.length; \result[i] == a + i);
      ensures a <= b ==> \fresh(\result);
      assigns \result[*];
      behavior complete;
      behavior disjoint;
    @*/
    public static int[] closedInterval(int a, int b) {
```

```
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

    }

```
```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    //@  requires true;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures (digits == null || digits.length == 0) ==> \result == true;
    //@ also
    //@  requires digits != null && digits.length > 0;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (
    //@            (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < digits.length/2;
    //@                 ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 0) ||
    //@                  (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1) ||
    //@                  (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8) ||
    //@                  (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9) ||
    //@                  (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6))
    //@            )
    //@            &&
    //@            (digits.length % 2 == 0 ||
    //@             (digits[digits.length/2] == 0 ||
    //@              digits[digits.length/2] == 1 ||
    //@              digits[digits.length/2] == 8))
    //@         );
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= len/2;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i ==>
        //@     ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0) ||
        //@      (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1) ||
        //@      (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||
        //@      (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9) ||
        //@      (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6));
        //@ loop_writes i, a, b;
        //@ decreases len/2 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i < A.length; (\forall int j; 0 <= j < A[0].length;
                 \result[i][j] == A[A.length - 1 - i][A[0].length - 1 - j]));
      behavior complete;
      behavior disjoint;
    @*/
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {

        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    //@  requires true;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures arr == null ==> \result == null;
    //@  ensures arr != null ==>
    //@            (\result != null
    //@             && \result.length == arr.length
    //@             && (\forall int k; 0 <= k < arr.length;
    //@                    (Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> \result[k] == arr[k])
    //@                 && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) && (k == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[k-1]))
    //@                        ==> \result[k] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[k]))
    //@                 && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) && !(k == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[k-1]))
    //@                        ==> \result[k] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[k]))
    //@                )
    //@            );
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@              (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j])
        //@           && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && (j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]))
        //@                 ==> ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j]))
        //@           && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && !(j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]))
        //@                 ==> ret[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]));
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i, wordStart;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
```

```
public class CompareArray {
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (a == b);
    //@ also
    //@  requires a != null && b != null && a.length != b.length;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ also
    //@  requires a != null && b != null && a.length == b.length;
    //@  assigns \nothing;

    //@ behaviors disjoint;

        //@ loop_writes i;

        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```
